test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
If the given sheet is folded to form a cube, which of the given figures is / are possible?

(The numbers are shown to indicate the sides only.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/559af29abf6eb1c4e73750bd6cb7f14278c8adf326c1dff0b469342d0f6e9faf.png] 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10f7a8e16cba1ebd1db8ad6251b7d394325892652fe730c12cdf0348199c44d3.png]
solution:
From the given open Cube:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e02250ccb06cd39690416abee91dc3a0cd91538e9d8ca5914c26408769898b9.png] 

2 and 1 is the opposite sides.

6 and 5 is the opposite sides.

3 and 4 is the opposite sides.

And, two opposite sides can not be the adjacent surfaces, so it can't be shows in a dice.

Now,

Cube 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ad914ae6fa74d2b2a00dfc9b2075936ac9f88633a994dbb114d6800bc2e0523.png] → Can not be made, because 2 and 1 is the opposite sides.

Cube 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cb473701c0aa325a6b0ad9f09bbec8436c952232b220d14f31c451ce03e84dd.png] → Can not be made, because 6 and 5 is the opposite sides.

Cube 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c4defabbdce6b12f92f51b6f1c1863b899b94b9832e9d0aab42c6f356f00fb0.png] → Can not be made, because 3 and 4 is the opposite sides.

Cube 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2c1aa7285c8881556474f037ea79633b7f3469c975af05092663fed5c9bc1d7.png] → Can be made, because all the surfaces are adjacent sides.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4"**.
